meta.parties: Pedrick Appuhamy v. Ekman Singho Et Al

rules.statement: A register kept by a Vel-Vidane for his own information and not in pursuance of an official duty imposed on him is not a public document within the meaning of section 74 of the Evidence Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "A register kept by a Vel-Vidane for his own information and not in pursuance of an official duty imposed on him is not a public document within the meaning of section 74 of the Evidence Ordinance."
